g.text: ATLAS advantage with paired patient-bootstrap uncertainty

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #203640

g.text: Points: unresampled mean error reductions. Bars: pointwise 95% percentile intervals from 5,000 paired resamples.

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #203640

g.text: Positive values favor ATLAS; zero indicates equal MAE. Amber indicates an interval that includes zero.

text.style: font-size: 8.2px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #203640

g.text: Duration-dependent: DynamicDeepHit-Lite at baseline; SurvTransformer-Discrete at L20/L23; Dynamic-DeepHit (optimized) at L24.

text.style: font-size: 8.2px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #203640

g.text: Competing risks: Weibull-MLP for baseline survival/Death B; Dynamic-DeepHit (optimized) for baseline Death A and all later targets.

text.style: font-size: 8.6px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #203640

g.text: Common Sobol sampler for ATLAS. Fits held fixed; intervals are not simultaneous and do not include model-selection or new-training-cohort uncertainty.
